events.event: Continues twelfth Indian Ocean/Bay patrol after 19-Feb miss; no new named attack through 3 Mar.
Continues outbound patrol southwest of Ceylon/Maldive approaches; on 4 Mar she will historically attack Fort McCloud, which remains outside this window.
Eastern Fleet reports a submarine periscope/practice-area threat and sends destroyers hunting southwest of Ceylon. Geometry makes I-162 plausible but not proven.
events.effect: RN exercises curtailed; no depth-charge damage or contact is credited.

events.event: Sinks British cargo ship Ascot around 05S 63E while continuing western Indian Ocean patrol.
events.effect: Commerce pressure continues without requiring a surface-raider sortie.

events.event: Glen reconnaissance flight over the Chagos Archipelago; no ships found.

SLEUTH_interaction: No submarine obtains a weapon-quality contact on Illustrious during the return. I-37 is far west; I-162 possible Ceylon-area presence remains uncorrelated.
